steps.action: Tap the online step

must_not: 'Your page is on' while visitors get nothing

'Link copied.' / 'Poster saved as a picture.'
'✓ You have shared your link.'

A poster with a broken logo
'You have shared your link' before any share

steps.action: Read 'How people pay'
user_sees: 'Pay at the gym desk': 'People who ask to join online pay at your desk on their first visit. Then you make them a member on Today.'; 'Pay online when they join' only when that is switched on at MettleUp; 'UPI at the desk' with the saved UPI ID or 'Add UPI ID'; then '✓ This step is done. You can come back here at any time.'
must_not: 'Pay online when they join' offered while the server switch is off
